item.title: Tech Talk – Understanding Transformers in Modern AI
item.description: In this Tech Talk hosted by miCoach, we explored the foundation of transformer-based architectures such as BERT and GPT, including self-attention mechanisms, token embeddings, and how they enable breakthroughs in language modeling and beyond.

item.title: Bootcamp – Practical Deep Learning with PyTorch
item.description: In this practical bootcamp, we guided participants through the foundations of deep learning using PyTorch — covering tensors, training loops, model design, and real-world applications.

item.title: Tech Talk – Deep Understanding of Deep Learning
item.description: We hosted a technical session for the miCoach community, explaining how deep learning models work under the hood — from linear algebra intuition to CNNs and Transformers.
